title: testjig: register PushSubscription/EmailPush on the mail memory backend; object-history EmailPush cases over HTTP
description: Follow-up of JMAP-r44n.16 / tna1.3.15. The jig registers no PushSubscription methods. Register jmap_server::register_push_subscription_handlers with the mail MemoryBackend (emailpush feature), advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:emailpush in Session capabilities and accountCapabilities (empty objects, -05 §2.1), and add HTTP tests in crate-jmap-testjig/tests/object_history_e2e.rs: an EmailPushConfig with objectHistory in properties is echoed and stored without it; a restored Email sends no EmailPush (the jig needs a delivery hook, e.g. a test-only deliver endpoint or direct MemoryBackend::deliver_email). Memory-level coverage already in crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/emailpush_history.rs.
